scripts.clean: bunx turbo clean && rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules plugins/*/node_modules
scripts.update:deps: for dir in apps/* packages/* plugins/*; do [ -d "$dir" ] && (cd "$dir" && echo "Updating $dir..." && bun update --latest); done

comments.pre-commit: Fast checks on staged files only (format, patterns)
comments.pre-push: Quick type check before pushing (turbo caches unchanged)
comments.ci: Full validation: lint, typecheck, build, test (source of truth)

*.{ts,tsx}: bash -c 'if grep -nE "(console\.(log|debug|info|warn)|debugger)" "$0"; then echo "❌ Error: Found console statements or debugger in $0" >&2 && exit 1; fi'
bash -c 'if grep -nE "\.only\(|\bfdescribe\(|\bfit\(" "$0"; then echo "❌ Error: Found .only() or focused tests in $0" >&2 && exit 1; fi'
bash -c 'if grep -nE "^(<{7}|>{7}|={7})" "$0"; then echo "❌ Error: Found merge conflict markers in $0" >&2 && exit 1; fi'
package.json: bash -c 'node -e "JSON.parse(require(\"fs\").readFileSync(\"$0\", \"utf8\"))" || (echo "❌ Error: Invalid JSON in $0" >&2 && exit 1)'
